name: Estonian University of Life Sciences
summary: Life sciences university in Tartu; its one English-taught degree is a 6-year integrated veterinary medicine, with 38 places and its own clinic.

ib.text: An IB Diploma taught in English meets the English rule; send results via IB's electronic transcript. Places go on the ISAT aptitude test and a motivation letter, not on IB points or subjects.

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year integrated bachelor's and master's in veterinary medicine, from animal anatomy and biology through pre-clinical and clinical study, with practical training in the university's own Animal Clinic.
programmes.ib: The ISAT is an online 3-hour aptitude test on reasoning; register for a sitting before its deadline.
programmes.selectionNote: ISAT aptitude test scaled to 40 points plus a motivation letter worth up to 10, ranked on a list. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: There is no application fee for the veterinary programme, and the tuition is the same for EU and non-EU students.
The ISAT can be taken only once in 12 months and only in fixed sittings, so book a sitting well before the application deadline.
The course is accredited by the European Association of Establishments for Veterinary Education (EAEVE).
